text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: KV cache fragmentation spike detected for continuous-batching (us-west1-inference-7). Metrics: kv_cache_frag_ratio=0.78, batch_latency_p50=260ms -> 420ms, p95=1.6s. Several backoff patterns and repeated cuda malloc failures observed. Paging: @vera-oncall

vera-oncall: On it. quick summary + impact?

sanjay: Seeing rapid growth of slab allocations in KV arena. PyTorch/CUDA logs show repeated `cudaMalloc` retries followed by fragmentation warnings. Continuous batching keeps growing batch sizes which amplifies KV cache pressure.

ashley: Customer-facing: api-prod requests increased 5xx for ~12 customers. Two customers (CID: C-8392, C-9102) saw request timeouts. Need immediate mitigation to stop further impact.

diego: Recommended emergency roll: reduce `CONT_BATCH_MAX_TOKENS` and cap `CONT_BATCH_WINDOW_MS` to prevent runaway batching. Also trigger arena compaction and lower `KV_CACHE_PERSISTENCE` temporarily.

morgan: Agreed. Plan:
1) Reduce batch cap
2) Disable continuous-batching on a small canary
3) Run arena compaction on affected hosts
4) Rollout hotpatch to all inference nodes if canary healthy

deploy-bot: Starting canary rollout (10%) to us-west1-inference-7. Patch applied to 6 pods.

sanjay: Commands to patch env on deployment:
```
kubectl -n inference patch deploy kv-inference --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/env/0/value","value":"32"}]'
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/kv-inference CONT_BATCH_WINDOW_MS=8 CONT_BATCH_MAX_TOKENS=32 KV_CACHE_COMPACT_INTERVAL=15s
```

ashley: Also toggle adaptive allocator heuristic to be more aggressive about merging slabs:
```
gcloud compute ssh inference-usw1-01 -- sudo /usr/local/bin/arena-compact --pool kvcache --aggressive
```

vera-oncall: Running compaction now on 3 hosts (inference-usw1-0{1..3}). Monitoring memory headroom.

incident-bot: Alert: `cudaMalloc` failures reduced after canary patch; p95 latency down to 520ms in canary cohort. Global errors still elevated but trending down.

diego: If canary stable for 10m, promote rollout. Also schedule a rolling restart with `LD_PRELOAD=libjemalloc.so` on remainder to reduce fragmentation amplification from glibc.

morgan: Noted. Starting promote to 50% -> 100% over 15m if no regression. I'll update postmortem notes.

ashley: Customer comms: sending 'we're investigating' to C-8392 and C-9102, marking incident as 'degraded'. PR to support queue: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4123

morgan: Handoff to night shift @sanjay in 30m. Summary: quick config hotpatch (batch cap/window), arena compaction, canary healthy, promotion in progress. Next steps: monitor KV frag ratio, run offline compaction sweep during low traffic, follow up with allocator tunable audit.

sanjay: I'll pick this up. Adding a runbook note: if p95>1s after promote, rollback by restoring previous env values and re-enable persistent caching.

vera-oncall: Before I go offline: snapshots of `/var/log/redwood/kv-alloc.log` uploaded to S3: s3://redwood-ops/incidents/3945678901/logs

morgan: Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

pagerduty-bot: Incident annotated, escalation to engineering lead scheduled at +1h if unresolved.

incident-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> partial (canary healthy, rolling promote ongoing). Will append timeline and postmortem ticket when stabilized.

morgan: Handoff complete. tagging @oncall-next for visibility. Good job folks.
